part1.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: The Rescue Boat Ran Out Of Fuel, One Man Hid His Arm (1/3) #shorts
part1.description:
If a rescue boat picks you up in an outbreak, don't relax. Count the people who won't show you their arms. 11 survivors, no fuel, no water, and something knocking inside the locked cabin.

Open it? Part 2 is up next.
#zombie #zombieapocalypse #survival #animation #storytime #shorts
part1.comment: Open it? 🚪 Would you open the cabin door? YES or NO 👇

part2.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: Drifting Back To A Beach With Hundreds Of Infected (2/3) #shorts
part2.description:
An anchor only stops a drifting boat if the rope reaches the bottom. Theirs is 20 feet short, the tide is pushing them back to a beach full of infected, and one survivor's eyes are turning white.

Jump in? Part 3 is up next.
#zombie #zombieapocalypse #survival #animation #storytime #shorts
part2.comment: Jump in? 🌊 Would you leave the boat? YES or NO 👇

part3.title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: 11 People, 4 Life Jackets, And The Trick That Saved Us (3/3) #shorts
part3.description:
Trousers float: knot the legs, swing them over your head to fill them with air, hold the waist underwater. 11 people, 4 life jackets, and the infected won't follow you into the sea.

Would you have jumped? Day 3 is tomorrow.
#zombie #zombieapocalypse #survival #animation #storytime #shorts
part3.comment: Jump in? 🌊 Would YOU have jumped? 👇
